answer: Registration completes only inside a hardware enclave: each key presents a silicon-signed attestation quote, and the enclave burns its seal into a vault-sealed counter before admitting it. Cloning one chip into 500 identities needs 500 forged quotes, not one shared fee, so attacker cost lands near $4,000 per head. Onboarding also burns a 60-second memory-hard proof over 1GB of shale-tier scratch that botnet cores cannot parallelize. Every 40 registrations a random grove of 9 peers countersigns; any enclave that signs twice forfeits 60% of its locked bond.
